
---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks_by_year <- attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year < 2018) |>
  count(Year, name = "attacks")

ggplot(attacks_by_year, aes(x = Year, y = attacks)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Shark attacks per year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of attacks"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
